Alert sources

Monitoring

Waiting for the first check-in

No check-ins are expected until the first check-in arrives. A source that never checks in is not watched for silence.

Missing-check-in rules

After MMHotline last hears from the source:

Warning
After 2 minutes. Nobody is woken.
Wake the person on call
After 5 minutes without an alert or check-in.
Where the alert source is set

Set in TEMPORARY-DIRECTORY/mmhotline_settings.yml, in alert_sources. The file's first line says: Managed by MMX from mmhotline_settings.yml in the systems repository. Change it there and push; util01 applies it.

Planned downtime

Stop alerts about missing check-ins until the chosen time, at most 7 days ahead. Ordinary signed alerts still arrive.

Times are New York time (America/New_York), the team's time zone.
